extension.description: A music-focused service addon that shows a notification overlay for the next track in your playlist or music addon. Automatically continues playback to the next song.
extension.news:
v1.0.6 - Add publish rule checks (pre-push hook and CI workflow); nothing in the add-on changes.
v1.0.5 - Rewinding out of the countdown no longer disables the overlay for the rest of the song or drops the queued next item. - The overlay is always cleared if the popup hits an error. - Handle each player event once instead of three times. - Fix the fallback dialog's remote key mapping (Next/Previous were swapped).
v1.0.4 - Add Claude Code project settings (not packaged).
v1.0.3 - Keep the service running after unexpected errors in the playback loop.
v1.0.2 - Keep playlist-backed playback passive and abort stale countdown advances.
v1.0.1 - Primez branch metadata/version bump for repository auto-updates.
